title: Lere language
description: Endangered Kainji dialect cluster of Nigeria
extract: Lere is an extinct Kainji dialect cluster of Nigeria. The ethnic population was cited as 16,000 in 2000, of whom only a few speak the language. A wordlist from the Takaya dialect can be found under External links.
